title: High school musical
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: Musical enthusiasts of our school have joined forces and created their own musical play.
content:
Inspiration for this project was found in the animated film called Sing. The students chose the motive themselves. At first it was difficult to decide, but as soon as the idea came to mind, they say the choice was obvious. The first two days were spent creating script, choreography and music. The script and choreography were made by the students themselves whereas the music is a combination of singing to a playback and lip syncing. The last day focused on the props and costumes. 

The students arranged everything mostly by themselves with minimal disagreement and there were no big problems with cooperation.The presentation takes place in the gymnastic hall, where the musical will be performed two times, starting at 9:30 and 10:30 The play will last just under thirty minutes.

title: Monastery sleepover
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: The students spent a night in a monastery, learning about how medieval books were made.
content:
The participants spend two days in the Broumov Monastery. Both days were packed with workshops about medieval writing, printing with wooden blocks and bookbinding. In their free time they got the chance to use the stimulating atmosphere of the building to write their own creative texts. The stay overnight gave them the chance to truly absorb the spirit of the place. 

Each student spent the last day putting together their own display. You will have the opportunity to appreciate many original pieces of work, both physical and intellectual. The displays will be accompanied with a presentation recounting the days in the monastery, including some photos and videos.

title: Nuances of design
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: Logos are small, yet often they are the most important thing of branding. How do you come up with something simple yet memorable?
content:
On the first day the participants attended a lecture in ZUŠ, where they gathered what makes a great logo and what might be considered unsuitable. On Wednesday they also visited the cinema to watch a relatively new Czech documentary film called Identita, mapping over a century of visual culture. The film relates some stories of small brands and their visual branding.

 On the last day the students threw themselves into work and designed their own logos, mainly for our school. Even though they had only a little time,  they managed to come up with some wonderful designs. Everything will be on display in their vernissage going on in room 109.

title: Castle architects
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: The main goal of this project was to get familiar with basic terms used in casteology and to create an accurate model of castle Vízmburg.
content:
On the first day, the participants of this project visited castle Vízmburg to get an idea of what it looked like in its prime and to make plans for a model they were planning to make. The students helped a little with the reconstruction and got the tickets for free in return. 

The rest of the week was spent building said model. They decided on a ratio approximately 1:40, at first using mainly cardboard and polystyrene, which they connected together with a glue gun.  Then they focused on smaller details made from straws, skewers, etc. The final result will be displayed alongside a presentation about the castle Vízmburg.

Word of the day: bergfried, castle tower for military defense and guarding, not for living.

title: Eko-klub vysadil 50 nových stromků v parku
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: Dobrovolníci z naší školy strávili sobotní dopoledne zvelebováním městské zeleně.
content:
Více než tři desítky studentů z Eko-klubu přiložily ruku k dílu a během sobotního dopoledne vysadily nové sazenice lip a dubů v městském parku. Akce proběhla ve spolupráci s odborem životního prostředí.

Děkujeme všem zúčastněným, kteří pomáhají dělat naše město zelenější a čistší!

title: Zahraniční exkurze do Londýna: Přihlašování spuštěno
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: Pětidenní poznávací zájezd do Spojeného království proběhne na jaře příštího roku.
content:
Kabinet anglického jazyka vyhlašuje přihlašování na jarní poznávací zájezd do Londýna a okolí. Program zahrnuje návštěvu historických památek, muzeí i známých filmových ateliérů.

Kapacita je omezená na 45 míst. Formuláře si můžete vyzvednout v kabinetu č. 204.

title: Rozhovor s vítězkou dějepisné olympiády
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: „Historie není jen o datech, ale o příbězích lidi,“ říká studentka 3. ročníku.
content: Přinášíme exkluzivní rozhovor s naší studentkou, která dosáhla mimořádného úspěchu v celostátním kole dějepisné olympiády. Jak probíhala její příprava, co ji na historii nejvíce baví a jaké má plány do budoucna se dočtete v tomto příspěvku.

title: Roll the dice
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: Whether you want to try a brand new game or play some old classic, this project is just for you.
content:
Board game lovers, you're in luck! This project focuses on a variety of tabletop games and their creation. The participants spent the week playing different kinds of games, while also competing in their tournament in Dobble and “Prší”.  The students also made a survey that focused on people’s relationship to board games. On Tuesday they asked people around the school, while on Wednesday they focused on strangers around the town. 

You can go see the results of the tournament and survey in room 208. There will also be a variety of classic board games like chess, Coadnames or Dixit, as well as brand new games that the students made themselves, which will all be available to try out.

title: Knižní klub doporučuje: Bestsellery tohoto podzimu
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: Hledáte skvělou knihu na sychravé večery? Zde je 5 tipů od členů našeho čtenářského kroužku.
content: Čtenářský klub připravil výběr nejzajímavějších knih letošního podzimu. Od napínavých detektivek až po inspirativní životopisy. Všechny doporučené tituly si navíc můžete zapůjčit v naší školní knihovně.

title: Školní časopis získal ocenění za grafický design
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: Náš redakční tým zabodoval v celostátní soutěži středoškolských časopisů.
content:
Redakce našeho časopisu slaví obrovský úspěch. V konkurenci více než padesáti škol z celé republiky jsme získali 1. místo v kategorii Nejlepší grafické zpracování a vizuální styl.

Děkujeme všem redaktorům a grafikům za jejich tvrdou práci!

title: Příprava na maturitu a přijímací zkoušky bez stresu
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: Odborné tipy, jak si efektivně rozvrhnout čas a zvládnout učení v klidu a pohodě.
content: Zkouškové období se blíží a s ním i stres. Školní poradenské pracoviště připravilo přehledný návod, jak plánovat učení, správně odpočívat a jak bojovat s prokrastinací. Nezapomínejte na spánek a pravidelný pohyb!

title: Mountain climbers
author: Konrádová, Zárubová
summary: A group of students covered over a hundred kilometres in three days while learning about our countryside.
content:
On Tuesday many brave students set off on a journey over the Gigant mountains with Mr. Trčka. In three days they managed to travel over one hundred kilometres, staying both nights in the school’s cabin Děvín.

They walked around a lot, covering at least thirty kilometers in a day, learning about the countryside and how it evolved through the years to what we are familiar with today. They got to know how to orient themselves in the mountains and how to work with a group. This experience strengthened everyone's physical endurance and demonstrated what the human body is capable of.
